summary: Established principles for a beginner: train each muscle two to three times a week with moderate volume, stop short of failure and progress gradually.

claims.claim: Training each major muscle group two to three times per week supports strength and muscle gain.
claims.applicability: Three full-body sessions a week cover each muscle group often enough.

claims.claim: Beginners progress well on modest weekly volume, adding sets gradually as recovery allows.
claims.applicability: Start near the low end of the volume range and add sets over the weeks.

claims.claim: Most sets can end one to three repetitions short of failure.
claims.applicability: Keep RPE around 7 to 8 while technique settles.

claims.claim: Joint discomfort is commonly managed by reducing range of motion or load and choosing supported variations.
claims.applicability: Prefer pain-free depth on knee-dominant exercises; seek a professional if pain persists.

cautions: See a qualified professional if joint pain persists or worsens.
